changes.summary: The United States implemented institution-wide sanctions against the International Criminal Court, with a six-month wind-down and four targeted general licenses.
changes.duplicate_review: Earlier ICC records concern sanctions on named judges, prosecutors or staff. This action blocks the institution itself and is a distinct legal and operational stage.

changes.summary: A presidential memorandum established a three-member inquiry and November 5 hearing into whether cause exists to remove Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook.
changes.duplicate_review: Existing Cook coverage concerns the attempted removal and Supreme Court proceedings. The formally constituted inquiry, hearing process and recommendation mandate are a distinct new executive action.

changes.summary: Early independent evidence found diesel prices had not declined and retailer uptake of the temporary tax relief remained limited pending implementation guidance.
changes.duplicate_review: Same October 5 diesel-relief order and effectiveness lifecycle; stable canonical ID retained rather than creating an outcome duplicate.
